design: Axolotl regeneration and memory conflict; visible external gills, fin, regenerating limbs, scars; restrained body horror.
Lynx tufted ears and bobtail retained; split-shadow asymmetry and restrained scar tissue.
Moth antennae, patterned wings and afterglow eyes; memory/afterimage theme.
A single original hybrid silhouette with feathered scales and asymmetric anatomy; no copied existing species.
